verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no built-in, in-product AI assistant that a user can delegate tasks to. Mercury's AI-related offerings are external-facing: an MCP server, CLI agent skills and an API that let the user's own third-party AI tools connect to Mercury. Narrow embedded AI automations, such as AI bill parsing and AI-powered bookkeeping automations, are adjacent features rather than a delegable assistant, so they earn no credit here.
